messages:
Elena (Partner Ops): Quick triage for next week's partner ops sync. We have 4 MDF asks in the pipeline and a request to refresh partner scorecards before tier decisions. Need to align criteria + budget.
Marco (Head Partnerships): Which partners?
Elena (Partner Ops): EdgeCloud (marketplace feature + co-sell), TitanCompute (hardware demo fleet for pilot), SysIntegrate (SI onboarding workshops), and BrightOps (regional reseller pilot). Total ask = $200k split across activities.
Li (Marketplace): For EdgeCloud we should prioritize paid placement + 2-week feature. Historical lift for featured is 22% trial increase. Need $35k for placements + $15k for co-marketing creative.
Omar (Finance): 200k is fine if we can show 6-9 month payback or strategic value (new market entry). Please attach expected pipeline by partner.
Rhea (Legal): Heads-up: any co-marketing with marketplace partners needs an MSA addendum and GDPR data-sharing clause if leads cross EU. That takes ~5 business days to review.
Marco (Head Partnerships): For tiers, I'm leaning to keep current bands but add a "Trial" rectangle for 90-day pilots. It avoids permanent tier creep. Agree to require measurable KPIs.
Elena (Partner Ops): Proposed pilot rubric (draft):
- Minimum partner co-fund: marketplace 25%, hardware/events 30%
- Mandatory SFDC campaign tagging + monthly cadence report
- Clear KPI: MQLs, pipeline $, activation rate
- Legal sign-off for data/marketing (Rhea)
(Omar) to produce payback table template.
Omar (Finance): I'll produce a spreadsheet template: baseline ARR, projected uplift %, pipeline conversion, expected closed-won within 6/9 months. Due Tue EOD.
Li (Marketplace): Also recommend a small A/B test for EdgeCloud creative vs baseline listing. If creative outperforms by >12% cv we keep placement for 30 more days. That needs tracking pixels (I'll coordinate).
Elena (Partner Ops): Action items:
- Li: EdgeCloud CTR/trial numbers + A/B tracking plan (Mon EOD)
- Marco: confirm TitanCompute demo fleet logistics + partner co-fund (Mon noon)
- Omar: payback template + budget split scenarios (Tue EOD)
- Rhea: draft MSA addendum checklist and estimated review time (Tue)
- Elena: update partner scorecard drafts with proposed KPI deltas and circulate (Tue noon)
ops-bot: Reminder: partner ops sync scheduled 1794135000. Upload materials to the shared folder by 1794133200.
Marco (Head Partnerships): One more nuance: TitanCompute asked whether dev credits can offset MDF. We should define a credits-to-cash equivalency. Suggest dev credit conversion = $150/hr * committed eng hours or market-rate equivalent. Thoughts?
Omar (Finance): Fine to accept credits as partial match. Need a conservative valuation and a clause that credits are booked as in-kind contribution; we still need cash for placement/ops.
Rhea (Legal): Add contractual clause: credits contribution must be documented with SOW and acceptance criteria. No retroactive credit substitutions.
Li (Marketplace): EdgeCloud also wants a co-billing arrangement for featured placements. Is that ok from finance side?
Omar (Finance): Co-billing ok if we map revenue share or credit offset in advance. Need clear invoicing milestone.
Elena (Partner Ops): Notes on scorecards: thinking of adding a short-term metric column "Pilot Outcome" which captures lift %, pipeline add, and whether partner qualifies for full tier upgrade. That keeps historical variance visible.
Marco (Head Partnerships): Good idea. Also propose a "Sunset" date for pilot benefits so we revert if outcomes don't meet KPIs.
Elena (Partner Ops): TL;DR: finalize scorecards + payback analysis by Tue EOD, MDF ask split proposal by Tue noon, legal checklist by Tue. We'll reconvene Wed AM to lock deck. :rocket:
Li (Marketplace): I'll post EdgeCloud numbers and the A/B test plan in the shared doc: https://docs.redwood.com/partners/mdf/edgecloud-a-b-test (will update)
Omar (Finance): Starting models now.
Rhea (Legal): Will draft addendum checklist and ping Marco for partner contact.
Marco (Head Partnerships): I'll reach out to TitanCompute and BrightOps today.
Elena (Partner Ops): Thanks all. If anyone hits delays, drop a note here.
